facts.fact: ISO's member record names AMANORM (Agence Malienne de Normalisation et de Promotion de la Qualité) as Mali's national standards body, an ISO full member body; the page carries no event date, so the published date 2026-09-03 is used.

systems.country_label: Agence Malienne de Normalisation et de Promotion de la Qualité
